a magnetically shielded environment can be achieved with ultra low residual fields and gradients by using a new type of magnetic shielding and a novel design of the experimental apparatus.
a magnetically shielded volume can be constructed that is free of external magnetic fields to a level that has not been previously achieved, with a field gradient less then 300 pT m−1.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the residual field of a magnetically shielded environment can be reduced to the sub-pT level and the field gradient can be reduced to less than 300 fT/m by using a two-layer shield with a high permeability inner layer and a low-permeability outer layer, and by using a special design of the outer layer.

a magnetically shielded environment with a residual field less than 1 nT and field gradients less than 1 pT/m can be achieved with a relatively simple two-layer magnetic shield, provided that the magnetic properties of the inner layer of the shield are carefully controlled.

the residual field and gradient of a magnetically shielded environment can be made arbitrarily low with a sufficient number of layers, and that a two-layer magnetic shielding is sufficient to achieve a field of less than 700 pT within a 1 m ×1 m ×1m volume.
